d:
It's a story of a border jumping farm boy named Billany and an apathetic womanizer simply called the "Happy Man" meeting and bonding with each other as they try to make each other's lives as bearable as possible.

It's just your average heartwarming prison story about two dudes becoming more than just friends with benefits.
